summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Content Link Downloader app. Backend APIs (8/8 tests passed), frontend UI and integration (all tests passed). Fixed one minor clipboard error handling bug in Dashboard.js.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/videos returns 41 rows with correct INF ID to platform mappings (INF50->instagram, INF171->tiktok, INF174->youtube, INF175->facebook)
Backend: GET /api/stats returns correct counts (total, pending, preparing, ready, error)
Backend: POST /api/videos/9/prepare successfully prepares TikTok row INF173 (creator: myfirst100k, duration: [0:00:50])
Backend: GET /api/videos/9/download?fmt=mp4 returns correct filename: myfirst100k_INF173_[0:00:50].mp4
Backend: GET /api/videos/9/download?fmt=mp3 returns correct filename: myfirst100k_INF173_[0:00:50].mp3
Backend: GET /api/videos/0/download?fmt=mp4 returns correct filename: ahorraconmarta_INF50_[0:00:52].mp4
Backend: GET /api/videos/10/download?fmt=mp4 returns 307 redirect for YouTube (by design, server IP blocked)
Backend: POST /api/videos/reset successfully clears all rows back to pending status
Frontend: Dashboard loads with correct KPI cards showing Total: 41, Ready: 1, Preparing: 0, Errors: 0
Frontend: Table displays all 41 rows correctly with proper data
Frontend: Platform filter dropdown works correctly (tested with YouTube filter showing 26 badges)
Frontend: Status filter dropdown works correctly (tested with ready filter)
Frontend: Search input filters rows by INF ID, creator, or URL substring
Frontend: Prepare button functionality works (clicked for INF173, status changed to preparing/ready)
Frontend: Download buttons (MP4 and MP3) are visible and enabled for ready rows
Frontend: Copy link button works with proper error handling (shows 'Copy manually' toast when clipboard permission denied)
Frontend: Theme toggle switches between light and dark modes correctly
Frontend: Bulk actions bar displays all buttons (Prepare All, Download All MP4, Download All MP3, Reset)
Frontend: Row actions display correctly based on status (Prepare for pending, Download buttons for ready, Retry for error)
Frontend: Thumbnails display correctly for prepared rows
